node.statement: Dimension dichotomy and selection: below the universal thresholds of lem-extcb-one-dimensional-corner-dimension, lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity, and lem-extcb1-close-corner-dimension, the numbers dim S_{R_a,Q} all equal one common d in {0,1}; additivity gives dim S_{v(I_r),Q}=r*d, close-compression range invariance gives dim S_{P,Q}=r*d, and the EXT-CB hypothesis S_{P,Q}!=0 forces d=1 and hence dim S_{P,Q}=r.
